06.14

  • *Region:** The Lands of Gore

    The Arch of Sod

    Connects to: to be added.

Here, at the edge of the wood where the dryads (05.14) now live is a great arch of sod held up over the ground by poles. Although the poles lean drunkenly and most of the grass has now died, brown stains of dried blood can be found by careful investigation under the arch. Obviously, this is the side where the ritual by which blood brothers are made was performed.

Connections:

  • The mule that lives at 08.15 became blood brothers with the Jester Prince here.

    Hooks:

  • Who made themselves blood brothers here?
  • Why does an arch of sod have to do with being blood brothers?
